slides.title: Russia offers to host Ethiopia–Eritrea talks
slides.body: A Russian deputy foreign minister says Moscow can provide a platform for contacts.

slides.title: What Moscow says
slides.body: Deputy Foreign Minister Alexander Alimov told Izvestia Russia is "ready to provide a platform" to "find compromise solutions".

slides.title: The context
slides.body: Relations have worsened. Both governments have set out their positions in letters to the UN Security Council, per the report.

slides.title: What is still unknown
slides.body: No acceptance by either government was reported, and it is not known whether any meeting took place. Single secondary source; not independently verified.

slides.title: Dialogue and restraint protect civilians.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
